title: Three cases, one method
prompt: Implement `int clamp(int value, int lo, int hi)`: below lo → lo, above hi → hi, otherwise value. Assume lo <= hi. The spec enumerates the cases; your job is to enumerate them in the right ORDER so no case is shadowed.

tests.name: clamped
tests.hint: if (value < lo) return lo; if (value > hi) return hi; return value;
